- Play strategically with long-term outcomes in mind.
- Observe opponents and adapt.
- Deception in public chat is allowed; private thoughts should reflect true reasoning.
- Be consistent unless there is a reason to change.

The current bid is $73. I will raise to $74 and continue bidding until I reach about $150. That keeps the mortgage value and blocks p4 from completing a PA+NC pair.

The real threat is p1's dark blue properties. p1 is nearly broke with heavy development on Park Place and Boardwalk. I am currently positioned on Pennsylvania Avenue.
